result.short_description: Brief Outage Resolved - VNOC Operator AMPATH Various Circuits
result.description: The listed affected is available following a brief outage. The VNOC contacted the vendor to investigate. The circuit was affected with a flap during the time reported as service switched back to its main route after previous event over our provider network from Santos, Brazil on July 30 19:33:54 UTC. No further outages are expected.
